meta.description: A configured tabular presentation of a saved query's result set. References a query item for its data; column overrides are table-column children (one per customised column, ordered by sortOrder — the flat one-level rule); columns absent from the children render with result-set defaults.

queryId.description: UUID of the query item that supplies this table's rows. The query is executed via the saved-query path (kanecta_run_query / POST /query/:id/run) — parameter binding, DB-level read-only guard, and row cap all apply. The table never embeds SQL of its own.

queryParams.description: Fixed parameter values passed to the query at execution time, keyed by query-param name. Merged over the query's own defaultValues (these win). Null means the query runs with its defaults alone. Genuine opaque JSON round-tripped as a unit → projects to a JSON column, never normalised.

defaultSortField.description: Result-set column the grid sorts by initially. Null means the result set's natural order (whatever ORDER BY the query itself declares).

defaultSortDirection.description: Initial sort direction for defaultSortField. Null (or an absent defaultSortField) means no grid-side sort is applied.

defaultFilters.description: Initial grid filter state, keyed by result-set column name, in the grid component's native filter-model shape (ag-grid). Applied client-side after the query runs — it narrows the display, not the query. Null means no initial filters. Genuine opaque JSON round-tripped as a unit → projects to a JSON column, never normalised.

pageSize.description: Rows per page in the grid's client-side pagination. Null means pagination is off — the grid scrolls the full fetched result set.

rowLimit.description: Maximum rows to fetch from the query for this table (passed as the run's rowLimit and clamped by the executor's hard cap). Null means the executor default. The grid surfaces a truncation notice when the result set was cut at this limit.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this table shows, displayed near the grid in Studio. Null falls back to the referenced query's own description.

sqlSchema: -- Built-in type: adapter handles storage natively.
